constructor-arg.value: select distinct sub.adsh AS accessionNumber, sub.filed as filingDate, sub.cik, ctm.symbol AS ticker, ctm.class_id as classId, td.series AS seriesId, td.value AS strategyNarrative, td.footnote as additionalStrategyNarrative
from sec_financials.submissions sub join sec_financials.text_disclosures td on sub.adsh = td.adsh join sec_financials.company_tickers_mf ctm on ctm.series_id = td.series

INSERT INTO analytics.benchmark_master ( benchmark_id, benchmark_name, benchmark_provider, benchmark_type, created_by, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( :benchmarkId, :benchmarkName, :benchmarkProvider, :benchmarkType, :createdBy, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (benchmark_name) DO UPDATE SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO analytics.fund_master ( series_id, cik, fund_name, fund_family, primary_ticker, investment_objective, strategy_narrative, strategy_type, benchmark_id, benchmark_name, created_by, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( :seriesId, :cik, :fundName, :fundFamily, :primaryTicker, :investmentObjective, :strategyNarrative, :strategyType, :benchmarkId, :benchmarkName, :createdBy, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (series_id) DO UPDATE SET cik = EXCLUDED.cik, fund_name = EXCLUDED.fund_name, fund_family = EXCLUDED.fund_family, primary_ticker = EXCLUDED.primary_ticker, investment_objective = EXCLUDED.investment_objective, strategy_narrative = EXCLUDED.strategy_narrative, strategy_type = EXCLUDED.strategy_type, benchmark_id = EXCLUDED.benchmark_id, benchmark_name = EXCLUDED.benchmark_name, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

select rule_id as ruleId, rule_name as ruleName, pattern, is_regex as isRegex, target_strategy as targetStrategy, priority, is_active as isActive from analytics.compliance_rules where is_active = true order by priority; ]

SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(pl.terse), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(pl.std), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(pl.verbose), ''), nf.measure ) AS raw_benchmark_name FROM sec_financials.numeric_facts nf LEFT JOIN sec_financials.presentation_labels pl ON nf.adsh = pl.adsh AND ( pl.tag = nf.measure OR pl.tag = CONCAT(nf.measure, 'Member') ) WHERE nf.tag IN (:benchmarkTags) AND (nf.class IS NULL OR TRIM(nf.class) = '') AND nf.measure IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(nf.measure) NOT IN (:excludedBenchmarks);

INSERT INTO analytics.benchmark_master ( benchmark_name, benchmark_provider, benchmark_type, created_by, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( :benchmarkName, :benchmarkProvider, :benchmarkType, :createdBy, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (benchmark_name) DO UPDATE SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

select bm.benchmark_id as benchmarkId, bm.benchmark_name as benchmarkName, bm.benchmark_provider as benchmarkProvider, bm.benchmark_type as benchmarkType from analytics.benchmark_master bm join analytics.fund_master fm on fm.benchmark_id = bm.benchmark_id where bm.benchmark_name = :benchmarkName ]

SELECT rule_id as ruleId, pattern, provider_name as providerName, default_type as defaultType, priority FROM analytics.benchmark_provider_rules WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY priority ASC, LENGTH(pattern) DESC ]

select fm.series_id as seriesId, fm.cik as cik, fm.fund_name as fundName, fm.fund_family as fundFamily, fm.primary_ticker as primaryTicker, fm.investment_objective as investmentObjective, fm.strategy_narrative as strategyNarrative, fm.strategy_type as strategyType, bm.benchmark_id as benchmarkId, bm.benchmark_name as benchmarkName from analytics.fund_master fm join analytics.benchmark_master bm on fm.benchmark_id = bm.benchmark_id where fm.series_id = :seriesId ]
